dialect.detail: JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based medical billing system, program ORAPI021S2V3 handling medical treatment content check (API integration module)

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt/billing software - API module for medical treatment act content check (診療行為内容チェック) with integrated input processing (入力一体化)
purpose.summary: This is an API integration module (V3) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It handles medical treatment act content checking and validation, processing patient information, insurance combinations, prescription data, and medical procedure codes. It interfaces with XML-based API requests/responses and coordinates with numerous subsystems via COPY books and CALL statements.

notable_features: 54 COPY book inclusions indicating large modular system
245 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
APIREQ-PATIENTINFOREQ PIC X(1000000) - 1MB field for XML payload
BINARY usage for API context/mode fields
LINKAGE SECTION with MCP (Message Control Program) areas
OCCURS 400 for warning message table and work treatment act table
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP database access
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (garbled in latin-1 view). This is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system used widely in Japanese medical practices. The program is large (4684 lines, ~198KB) with extensive copybook usage typical of ORCA. Source truncated at 16000 chars but enough context is available for confident classification.
